additional_concerns: Candidate node.ad3ed6f7c586444ec7213491 adds nav > 0 to scope without source support. This returns OUT_OF_SCOPE even when an applicable SFC designation is established. A numerical validity prerequisite should not silently narrow the circular's legal scope or disable the independent designation route.
The doubled exposure sum in node.ad3ed6f7c586444ec7213491 correctly expresses the inclusive 50% threshold in exact common units; it is not double-counting exposure for this comparison.

Both candidates delegate exposure identification and measurement to supplied facts. Neither establishes a look-through, valuation, netting or measurement-date methodology. The second candidate expressly retains uncertainty where the governing measurement basis is unresolved.

Footnote 7 places the holistic designation assessment in cases below 50% of NAV. An OR with an actual operative designation preserves the affirmative classification outcome without implementing the SFC's discretion. Neither representation should be read as permitting managers to designate a Fund merely because risk factors are present.
The supplied dependency IDs have no authority names or source hashes. No reliable mapping from these IDs to particular missing authorities can be inferred.

Neither route establishes reclassification persistence after exposure falls below the threshold. A false result must retain the candidates' stated limits and must not become sale approval or a comprehensive non-complex classification.
